lighting_notes: Dim, isolated lighting — a single practical light over the dining table, rest of the apartment dark. Low Directional/Sky Light intensity, no fill, to emphasize Ananya's loneliness. A visible wall clock reading past 2:00 AM is a key prop — needs its own insert shot.
action: Ananya sits alone at a dimly lit table; a cooked meal sits cold. She stares at the clock ticking past 2:00 AM. The front door unlocks — Rohit enters, adjusting his jacket, glances at her with utter indifference, skips any greeting, walks straight to the bedroom, leaving her in silence.

dialogue.line: You didn't answer my calls again.
I was busy. Don't crowd me.

shot_list.description: Ananya alone at the table, establishes the isolation
Rohit entering, the brief exchange, his exit to the bedroom

continuity_notes: First appearance of the apartment location, reused again in sc09 for the climax. Establishes Rohit's coldness before sc05 reveals why.
